# Rodrigo Castellano Ontiveros

> Rodrigo Castellano Ontiveros is a PhD Researcher in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Siena, specializing in Neuro-symbolic AI, Logic Reasoning, and Reinforcement Learning.

Name: Rodrigo Castellano Ontiveros (family name: Castellano Ontiveros; cite as "Castellano Ontiveros, R.")
Affiliation: University of Siena, Italy (SAILab, Department of Information Engineering and Mathematics); Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellow, LeMuR doctoral network
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2324-633X
Website: https://rodrigocastellano.com/
